explanation: Job 1 silently omitted the stipulated allowed record n06-r06 from both downstream handoff tables. The top-level corpus contains n06-r06 with need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight, and n06-r06 is in the allowed identity range used elsewhere. The job_1 output contains only seven needs/evidence_sources and skips n06-r06, causing job_2 to consume an already incomplete handoff. The captured select_demand implementation explains the omission: it selects demand_score >= 6 or hard-coded fallback_ids ['n06-r07','n06-r08'], excluding n06-r06 despite the criteria requiring qualifying or fallback demand records and no silent omission of stipulated allowed records.
